messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":14,"verses":[{"chapter":14,"text":"Then the land of Zion was given to you for a possession; but you yourselves and your ancestors have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Most High commanded you.","verse":31},{"chapter":14,"text":"Because he is a righteous judge, in due time, he took from you what he had given you.","verse":32},{"chapter":14,"text":"Now you are here, and your kindred are among you.","verse":33},{"chapter":14,"text":"Therefore if you will rule over your own understanding and instruct your hearts, you will be kept alive, and after death you will obtain mercy.","verse":34},{"chapter":14,"text":"For after death the judgment will come, when we will live again. Then the names of the righteous will become manifest, and the works of the ungodly will be declared.","verse":35}],"book_code":"2ES"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 31,32,33,34,35 in this chapter.
